object: H2-loss-terms: losses of Section 4 (unfinished and cut trails, repeats, key false matches, aborts)
question: R2 own recount of every loss term of proof.md Section 4
number: Recounted from the plan: unfinished-trail sum P(Gamma(7) > 28) = 5.825e-7 (proof 5.8e-7); trails Q/L = 16,365.2, cut-trail mean 0.1006, P(K=0,1,2) = 0.9043 0.0909 0.0046, P(K>=3) = 1.57e-4; success lowered by K=1: 3.53e-4, K=2: 7.97e-4 (proof 3.5e-4, 8.0e-4); cut-trail deficit 9.70e-5 (proof 9.7e-5); pairs inside one trail Q L/N = 2^-14.00; 64-bit key false matches among 18,432 entries 9.2e-12 = 2^-36.7 (proof below 2^-36); table-overflow Chernoff ln P = -125.5 (proof e^-125.5); stage-2 exponent 3.06e28; lambda_eff = U(U-1)/2N = 0.49700, 1 - exp(-0.497) = 0.39165. All reproduced. One finding: the cut-trail deficit 9.7e-5 already contains the K>=3 term (1.5e-4 x 0.3916 = 6.1e-5), and the loss sum then adds 6.1e-5 again (6e-7 + 6.1e-5 + 9.7e-5): that term is counted twice, so the real loss is about 9.8e-5 not 1.6e-4. Conservative, no error against the claim. Margins in the entry: 0.0015 kept margin (worth 0.0032 bit if spent, lambda 0.4948 for p = 0.39 + 1.6e-4), double count 6.1e-5 worth about 0.00015 bit.
